facts.fact: 照片说明：四岁那年她在海湾与姐姐、表姐、弟弟一起游泳
facts.anchor: Swimming in the bay at four years old with my sister Mary, my cousin Maureen, and my brother Pat.

facts.fact: 照片说明：1983 年夏天她坐在 104 街的救生椅上
facts.anchor: On the lifeguard chair at Beach 104th Street in the summer of 1983.

facts.fact: 照片说明：第一年救生员表演标准的啤酒桶站立姿势
facts.anchor: A first-year lifeguard showing off perfect keg-stand form.

facts.fact: 照片说明：与 Bob 参加康尼岛举办的纽约市铁人三项后，胸前挂着奖牌合影
facts.anchor: Bob and me with our medals after participating in the NYC triathlon held at Coney Island.

facts.fact: 照片说明：救生员 Jennifer Tubridy 和姐妹俩在 97 街下班后实施了一次救援
facts.anchor: Lifeguard Jennifer Tubridy and her sisters performed an off-duty rescue at 97th Street.

facts.fact: 照片说明：到那时她已被称作 Chief Fash（Fash 队长）
facts.anchor: At this point, I was known as Chief Fash.

facts.fact: 照片说明：同事在 95 街配五名救生员，她在 96 街只有两名
facts.anchor: His chair on Beach 95th Street had five lifeguards, while mine at Beach 96th Street only had two.

facts.fact: 照片说明：她的孩子们和表亲坐上救生椅，学习盯着海洋看是什么滋味
facts.anchor: My children and their cousins on the lifeguard chair, learning what it’s like to observe the ocean.
